title: Find the government's recommendation to Web Summit as a published text
summary: Web Summit says the government "formally advised" it. We have the Prime Minister's words through a press live blog only. Is the advice published on a government page?
closes: A government address (portugal.gov.pt or a ministry) with the text, or a report in which the government says it was given by word only. A second independent report also helps (it stays evidence).
